dataCollected.title: Personal Information We Collect
dataCollected.body:
SanoTalk collects the following personal information:

- **Identity**: name, email address, role (patient, doctor, pharmacist)
- **Health data**: vital signs, medications, symptoms, allergies, chronic conditions, RAMQ number. All health data is encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM encryption with row-level security, ensuring that no one — including database administrators — can access your data in plaintext.
- **Communications**: chat messages with AI agents, consultation transcripts, session recordings. All communications are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM encryption with row-level security to protect the confidentiality of your exchanges.
- **Technical data**: IP address, browser type, device information, session tokens
- **Usage data**: feature usage, saved conversations, task boards

purposes.title: Why We Collect Your Data
purposes.body:
We collect and use your personal information for the following purposes:

- Providing healthcare support features (AI agents, consultations, health tracking)
- Authenticating your identity and securing your account (2FA, email verification)
- Enabling communication between patients and healthcare professionals
- Generating AI-powered health summaries and recommendations
- Improving our services and user experience
- Complying with legal and regulatory obligations

retention.title: How Long We Keep Your Data
retention.body:
We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active and as required by applicable law:

- **Health records** (vitals, medications, symptoms, allergies): 5 years
- **Chat messages and saved conversations**: 1 year
- **Consultation transcripts**: 2 years
- **Technical logs**: 90 days

You may request deletion of your data at any time through your profile settings.

thirdPartyAccess.title: Third-Party Access
thirdPartyAccess.body:
Your data may be processed by the following third-party services:

- **Anthropic** (AI language model provider) — chat messages are sent to generate AI responses
- **Deepgram** — audio transcription during live consultations
- **LiveKit** — real-time audio/video communication
- **Resend** — transactional emails (verification, notifications)

We do not sell your personal information. Health data is never shared with third parties for advertising purposes.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.body:
Under Quebec's Law 25 (Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector), you have the right to:

- **Access** your personal information
- **Rectify** inaccurate information
- **Delete** your personal information (right to erasure)
- **Data portability** — receive your data in a structured, commonly used format (JSON)
- **Withdraw consent** to non-essential data processing at any time
- **Be informed** about automated decision-making processes

howToExerciseRights.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
howToExerciseRights.body:
You can exercise your rights directly within SanoTalk:

- **Download your data**: Go to Profile > Privacy & Data > Download My Data
- **Delete your account**: Go to Profile > Privacy & Data > Delete My Account
- **Manage cookie preferences**: Click "Manage Cookies" in the footer
- **Contact us**: Email our Privacy Officer at the address below for any other request

We will respond to your request within 30 days.

privacyOfficer.title: Privacy Officer
privacyOfficer.body: Our Privacy Officer is responsible for ensuring compliance with privacy legislation. For any questions, concerns, or requests regarding your personal information, please contact:

aiTransparency.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence
aiTransparency.body:
SanoTalk uses artificial intelligence (AI) in several features:

- **Health AI Assistant** — answers health questions and provides triage guidance
- **Wellness Companion** — supports conversations about wellness and lifestyle
- **Pharmacist AI Agent** — provides medication and dosage guidance
- **Drug Info** — looks up drug side effects and interactions via external databases
- **News AI Agent** — summarizes health news
- **Consultation summaries** — AI-generated summaries of medical consultations

AI-generated content is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. You can always request a review by a qualified healthcare professional. AI responses may contain errors — always verify critical medical information with your healthcare provider.

**Health data sharing with AI agents**: By default, AI agents do **not** have access to your personal health data (health profile, vital signs, medications, symptoms, allergies, chronic conditions). To receive personalized AI responses, you must explicitly enable health data sharing in your **Profile > Privacy & Data** settings. You can disable this option at any time, and AI agents will then provide only generic responses.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.body:
SanoTalk uses the following types of cookies:

- **Essential cookies**: Required for authentication and security (session tokens). These cannot be disabled.
- **Analytics cookies**: Used to understand how users interact with our application (OpenReplay session replay). These are optional and require your explicit consent.

You can manage your cookie preferences at any time using the "Manage Cookies" link in the footer.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a notice in the application. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when this policy was last revised.

banner.description: We use essential cookies for authentication and optional analytics cookies to improve our services. You can accept or reject non-essential cookies.
